Every Friday, we’re releasing a classic film remastered in 4K and colour, perfect for the big screen! 🍿

This week, we're revisiting Tongue Tied. First released in 2012, the original film has been viewed more than 13 million times. Now, enjoy it all over again in full colour and 4K.
